Name: Immutable Core
Notes: lets Duelists/Legionnaires dabble (mid CON), but true tanks get peak value

Name: Last Bastion
Notes: this makes “bruiser tanks” real; discourages pure DEF-stacking from also being best damage

Name: Zone of Denial
Notes: ensures the control tank must actually be DEF-forward, not just HP sponge

Name: Perfect Flow
Notes: high ceiling for Duelists; speedcasters can hit it if they invest

Name: Phase Reposition
Notes: primary SPD prevents “DEX-only crit builds” from also being best gap-closers

Name: Hyper Awareness
Notes: gives glass builds survival options, but requires real durability investment to become oppressive

Name: Master Scaling
Notes: this is your “true weapon master” capstone — should demand commitment

Name: Endless Chain
Notes: this avoids “only offense stats” and forces endurance to sustain the loop

Name: Disarm Technique
Notes: makes disruption builds viable for Legionnaire/Tank hybrids without making Duelist default best disarmer

Name: Arcane Overload
Notes: forces casters to invest in survivability/anti-magic to reach peak output

Name: Spell Weaving
Notes: explicitly supports battlemage + spellblade without making pure Mage always best

Name: Reality Distortion
Notes: makes anti-resource control belong to defensive casters / monks more than glass cannons

Name: Divine Overflow
Notes: prevents pure heal-bot from also being best DPS unless they invest

Name: Purity Field
Notes: makes “purifier” a durable archetype, not a fragile dispel spammer

Name: Predator Momentum
Notes: keeps execute identity STR-forward; SPD is still relevant but not mandatory-max

Name: Blood Surge
Notes: snowball requires tempo and damage; avoids “fast but weak resets forever”

Name: Frenzy Pressure
Notes: if you want anti-tank, it should come from bruisers who can stay in range, not pure assassins
